name: Nadia
dof_breakdown: 7-DoF electric arms, 3-DoF electric pelvis, 2-DoF hydraulic torso, hydraulic legs
summary: A gymnast-inspired humanoid from the Florida Institute for Human and Machine Cognition, the team that placed second at the DARPA Robotics Challenge. It mixes electric arms and pelvis with compact hydraulic legs and torso for a human-like range of motion, and was built with Boardwalk Robotics, which Foundation later acquired.
